column4: Provide one router-authorized read-only evidence path for the GL-MT3000: either make the router reachable from mesh-home and authorize a read-only SSH/API identity for WAN, uptime, radio, and system-log reads, or provide a timestamped export of those same fields/logs covering a reported outage. Do not send credentials or private keys in chat or the repository. Retry the dependent root-cause-access task only after the authenticated path or export is available.
